title: Minimize the Graph
statement: The task is the fewest edges preserving reachability in a DAG where each vertex i receives edges from every j in an interval [l_i, r_i] below it, with sum of n up to 3·10^5 and Θ(n²) edges. It is the transitive reduction: edge j→i survives iff j's smallest successor exceeds r_i, meaning no interval of a vertex up to r_i covers j, counted by a Fenwick-tree sweep over r.
